behavior: A profile keeps saved clients (name, billing email, address, country, tax/VAT ID), and a new invoice picks one and keeps a copy of its details (PLAN 10.1)
acceptance: The api saves, lists and deletes a profile's clients: PUT to a client id saves one client per id (201 then 200), at most 1000 per profile, the invoice client rules apply, another user gets 403 and another profile's client id 404

An invoice stores the client's country and tax ID as part of its never-changing details; editing or deleting a saved client leaves the invoice as it was; the owner's invoice page and the invoice PDF show them, the PDF never the email

The Clients page (freelancer and merchant) adds, edits and deletes clients; the new invoice form fills the client from a saved client and sends its details; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations and a 390 px phone has no sideways scroll
notes: 2026-10-16 review pass by reviewer: Independent review: ownership SQL, immutability trigger and view (Up and Down), idempotency hash and PDF privacy correct. Fixed after review: cap race (profile row lock plus a deterministic in-flight test), client_not_found in the spec's error codes, client routes in the cross-user test, web and backend architecture docs, duplicate limits and dead copy, picker clearing unrelated errors, phone width check. Left as nits: duplicate 422 message parser, generic message at the 1000-client cap, second Intl.DisplayNames constant.

proof.1: unit: TestClients (PUT 201 then 200 per id, list by name, 422 rules, 1001st client 422 while editing works, Bob 403, another profile's client id 404, DELETE 204 then 404); TestProfilesBelongToTheirUser now covers the three client routes; TestSaveClientCapCountsASaveInFlight proves a save waits for one in flight and the cap holds (fails without the profile lock)
proof.2: unit: TestInvoiceNumbers rejects updates to client_country and client_tax_id; TestCreateInvoiceStoresDetails stores and returns country and taxId, and a changed country or tax ID is an idempotency conflict; TestInvoicePDF prints 'BILL TO Bob Ltd Main St 1 Berlin DE Tax ID DE999999999' and never the email; TestClients finds the invoice's copy unchanged after its client is edited and deleted
proof.3: e2e: invoices.spec merchant test saves a client (axe 0), picks it on New invoice, the invoice page shows Germany and the tax ID and keeps them after the client is deleted; the phone test opens Clients and its form with sidewaysScroll <= 0; new-invoice-form.test sends the saved client's details

Fixed after review: cap race (profile row lock plus a deterministic in-flight test), client_not_found in the spec's error codes, client routes in the cross-user test, web and backend architecture docs, duplicate limits and dead copy, picker clearing unrelated errors, phone width check. Left as nits: duplicate 422 message parser, generic message at the 1000-client cap, second Intl.DisplayNames constant.
